# source => value or diagnostic; calls accept one trailing comma, not empty arguments
fn add(a, b) { a + b }; add(2, 3,) => 5
fn id(x) { x }; id(sum([1, 2,],),) => 3
sum([1, 2,],) => 3
len([1, 2,],) => 2
0 && missing(7,) => 0
1 || missing(7,) => 1
fn id(x) { x }; id(1, 2,) => wrong argument count
sum(,) => expected integer
sum([1],,) => expected integer
0 && missing(1,,) => expected integer
fn id(x) { x }; id(,1) => expected integer
